name: tankoban-catalogue-smoke
comment: Catalogue-independence Slice 3 (2026-08-20): PARTIAL scenario, committed honestly. Proven live in isolated tagged sessions: a fresh tag gates world content behind account onboarding (accountHost/accountWelcomeContinueLocal - undocumented until this slice, since Main.qml overrides AccountOnboardingHost's own objectName to "accountHost") and Tankoban is reachable (modePill_Tankoban). The masthead/shelf steps this scenario exists to prove (tankobanSeriesMasthead, tankobanShelfState, the One Piece/Vagabond pinned series) are NOT included here: reaching a series page without the Discover wall's documented un-scrollable-GridView gap (Slice 2 ledger) requires the 'Top in Tankoban - Manga' rail under the Manga tab, and driving live (isolated sessions tk3d/tk3e/tk3f/tk3g, 2026-08-20) found the Tankoban WorldTabBar's Repeater materializes only a SUBSET of its 4 modeled tab pills at runtime (tankobanTab_library confirmed present and clickable via dump-ui; tankobanTab_manga and tankobanTab_discover both NO_SUCH_ITEM/WAIT_TIMEOUT across two independent fresh-tag sessions) even though qml/TankobanWorld.qml's tabModel unambiguously lists all four (discover/manga/comics/library) and the Discover tab's own content renders correctly by default (TankobanDiscoverPage's wall visibly matches source). Root cause not resolved within this slice's fence - named as a Bridge/runtime gap, not guessed around. See docs/colosseum-lanista-verification.md 'Tankoban catalogue-independence Slice 3' for the full writeup. Isolated tagged session on a unique pipe; never the daily pipe.
